description:
The SwaRD (Software Requirements Dataset) is a curated collection of requirements identified from multiple publicly available sources using ReqSeek. The constituent sources are governed by different licenses; therefore, SwaRD is not distributed under a unified license.

For detailed source-specific licensing and attribution information, consult the dataset metadata through `dataset.info.license` or the accompanying `dataset_info.json` file.

**Creator:** Mohammad Kasra Habib  
**Affiliation at the time of research:** Technical University of Munich (TUM), Germany

**Associated Research:** *ReqSeek: Transformer-Based Automatic Requirements Identification for Building Large Requirements Datasets*

**Dataset Repository:** https://huggingface.co/datasets/kasrahabib/SwaRD

**Replication Package:** https://github.com/kasrahabib/ReqSeek

**Release scope:** This public version excludes selected sources pending redistribution permission. The associated paper reports results from the complete research dataset; thus its counts may differ from this release.

# SwaRD: A Composite Dataset for Software Requirements Research --- Licensing and Attribution ## **License and Usage Notice** The **SwaRD** dataset is an identified collection that aggregates data from multiple publicly available sources, each governed by its own license terms. While all source datasets are available for research and academic purposes, they are not uniformly licensed, and therefore **SwaRD is not distributed under a unified license**. ## **Important Notice to Users:** • Each constituent dataset retains its original license as specified in its source.
• Users are responsible for reviewing and complying with the license terms associated with each dataset before reuse or redistribution.
• Attribution to original authors and repositories is provided in the *Dataset Attributions by License* section.
The authors of SwaRD have made every effort to preserve the provenance and licensing details of all incorporated data. However, we do not claim any rights beyond those granted by the original licensors and do not provide any warranty or legal advice regarding the reuse of third-party datasets. **If you wish to use SwaRD or any of its components in your own work, please ensure that you consult and adhere to the relevant license conditions and cite the corresponding original sources as specified.** **Citation Request:** If you use SwaRD in your research, please cite the associated study, *ReqSeek: Transformer-Based Automatic Requirements Identification for Building Large Requirements Datasets*, by Mohammad Kasra Habib, Umm-e-Habiba, Daniel Graziotin, and Stefan Wagner. This citation is requested in addition to any citations required by the original data sources. For up-to-date citation information, see the [ReqSeek repository](https://github.com/kasrahabib/ReqSeek). **Note:** The responsibility for license compliance lies with the end user. Please consult the original dataset licenses to ensure appropriate usage. **Public release scope:** This release excludes selected source datasets while redistribution permissions are clarified.
